title: The Score Finish checklist, version 1 (SCORE_FINISH_SPEC.md Appendix A)
frozen: September 29, 2026 — taken at the recommended default of SCORE_FINISH_SPEC.md §6 row 2 under the user's 'proceed' (the user may amend; a new version re-reads the baseline archive before comparing, §4.3)
rule: §4.4: both floors pass and no verified open P1 in the pillar -> 5.5 + 0.5 per ceiling passed; otherwise 5.0 + 0.25 per ceiling, at most 6.0. Exercised at >= 6 of 8 measured; 6-7 measured = a range; < 6 = NOT EXERCISED.
done_when: 56 of 84 ceilings passed with every floor green = every pillar at its target = the directional 7.5

kinds.AUTO: read from the digests, tests and tools
kinds.PROBE: a small read-only probe in tools/_score_probes.py
kinds.EYES: a person or a screenshot; the user's marks override the panel's
